text_block_list.text:
I was carrying a stack of folding chairs 
to use for the meeting, but—

The sheer weight made me stumble, and I 
lost my balance...!! My body tipped over, 
and the chairs slipped from my hands...!!

I squeezed my eyes shut and braced for the 
crash and the pain— ...However.

—Whoa there. Were you chasing after the 
forbidden fruit of eternity?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A pity. ...The immortal paradise is still 
far away.

After standing back up, I finally grasped 
the situation. Apparently, Tanino Gimlet 
had rushed over and caught me.

What's more, all the folding chairs that 
should have scattered were neatly lined up 
on the floor.
choice_data_list:
(Did she catch all of them in that split 
second...?)

(Did she catch all of them in that split 
second...?)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter? What has left you so 
astonished?

I told her I was amazed that she had not 
only supported my weight in an instant, 
but caught all the chairs just as swiftly.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... I see. Then to me, such a feat 
is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You must know... the great artists who 
forged the Renaissance were masters of not 
just the humanities, but the sciences as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am the same. I seek not only the royal 
road, but dynamic change as well.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The keen acumen of science. The precise 
methods. —In other words, refined "Speed."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The enduring solidity of humanities. The 
paradigm of all phenomena. —In other 
words, unshakeable "Power."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Only when possessing both does one's 
existence gain true gravity, intoxicating 
all who bear witness...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have no hesitation in 
pursuing both! I, myself—shall seize both 
crowns in my grasp! Heh, hahaha!! 
Aaaahahahaha!!

I didn't quite get all of it... but I at 
least understood the words "Speed" and 
"Power."

She simply wants to pursue both, it seems. 
...Probably.
S-So freaking cooool!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was watching from over there, and you 
were crazy fast!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Not a single chair got busted, either...! 
How the heck'd you do that!!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... a keen eye you have. As expected of 
one who stays true to her own aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, follow me. I shall impart 
unto you the path to paradise.

All I understood was... her devotion to 
"Speed" and "Power." With her, perhaps she 
really could accomplish something brand 
new.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, it is about time I take my 
leave.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For I must chart the map to grasp the 
eternal fruit.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We shall meet again when chance permits. 
—I await you beyond the voyage.

As I pondered what she could have meant... 
I noticed someone else seeing Tanino 
Gimlet off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Pursuing too much leads to collapse.

Having said only that, she walked away. 
Could she be worried about something...?
